name: Realtime API & WebSocket/SSE
description: Realtime API & WebSocket/SSE standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-API-RT applies.

rules.title: Define realtime connection lifecycle
rules.detail: Specify connect, authenticate, subscribe/join, disconnect, reconnect and re-subscribe behavior explicitly.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define realtime connection lifecycle.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define realtime connection lifecycle.

rules.title: Define event envelope and versioning
rules.detail: Events have stable type, id, timestamp/version and payload schema so clients can route, deduplicate and evolve safely.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define event envelope and versioning.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define event envelope and versioning.

rules.title: Handle missed and duplicate events
rules.detail: Clients/services define sequence/checkpoint/history reconciliation or another strategy when events are lost, repeated or received after reconnect.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Handle missed and duplicate events.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Handle missed and duplicate events.

rules.title: Refresh authentication without forcing unsafe permanent tokens
rules.detail: Define token expiry, refresh/re-authentication and authorization re-check for long-lived connections.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Refresh authentication without forcing unsafe permanent tokens.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Refresh authentication without forcing unsafe permanent tokens.

rules.title: Bound reconnect and heartbeat behavior
rules.detail: Use backoff/jitter, heartbeat/idle timeout and maximum retry pressure to prevent reconnect storms.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Bound reconnect and heartbeat behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Bound reconnect and heartbeat behavior.

rules.title: Treat server state as authoritative
rules.detail: Optimistic client state must reconcile with authoritative history/snapshot after reconnect or detected gaps.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Treat server state as authoritative.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Treat server state as authoritative.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-API-RT applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Realtime API & WebSocket/SSE to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Realtime API & WebSocket/SSE is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Realtime API & WebSocket/SSE failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
